name: astralanime
description: Astralanime — anime discovery and tracking. AniList and MyAnimeList catalogues, AniList sign-in, local library.

scripts.serve: npm run prepare:web && npx --yes http-server www -p 5173 -c-1
scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
